title.full: Telling CPF about your new address

summary.text: Change your address through ICA e-Services with Singpass. CPF Board will be told within one day.

details.heading: Where CPF letters go
details.body: CPF letters go to the home address on your Singapore Identity Card.

details.heading: No separate reply from CPF
details.body: CPF Board will not send you another acknowledgement for this change.

example_phrasings: I moved house but CPF letters still go to my old address

sources.page_title: How do I inform CPF Board of a change in my address?

quotes.text: By default, CPF letters are sent to your residential address on your Singapore Identity Card.

If you are residing at a new address and have been receiving your CPF letters at your old residential address, please apply for the change of your residential address (local or overseas) via Immigration & Checkpoints Authority’s (ICA) e-Services using your Singpass.

Participating government agencies and statutory boards (including CPF Board) will be informed of the change in address through the One-Stop Change of Address Reporting Service (OSCARS) within one day.
You will not be receiving an additional acknowledgement from CPF Board for updates via OSCARS.
